messages.author: de177324d543700d
messages.subject: Permutation Analysis for SNP Significance?
parts:
Hi all,

I'm fairly new to QTL analysis.  I've been able to do SNP analysis and use the drop_hilit argument while plotting, but as far as I can tell it's only possible to hilight SNPs that fall within an arbitrary LOD drop value of the top SNP.

Is there any way to run a permutation analysis to identify significance thresholds for SNP LOD scores (similar to `scan1perm()`)?

Thanks,
Zack

messages.subject: Re: Permutation Analysis for SNP Significance?
